reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the redline is byte-identical to the original with no comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

The cited text supports the conclusion: §2.7 is a standard license-use restriction (no copying, reverse engineering) and §13.6 affirmatively preserves each party's independent development rights — neither restrains what businesses Corio may operate or what products it may buy or build.

The 'Corio Market Segment' (§1.3) and 'Territory' (§1.11) definitions delimit the scope of the license grant rather than impose a covenant not to compete or a prohibition on Corio's other activities; the rationale expressly reasons through this borderline point, and the deterministic check confirms no open-ended compete restriction on Customer.

Rationale accurately notes the only competitor reference (§14.1) is an assignment-consent right and that Exhibit D marketing cooperation is non-binding, so no actionable deviation exists under NONCOMPETE.
